messages.content: List all song names by singers above the average age.

db.singer.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": None, "avg_age": {"$avg": "$Age"}, "rows": {"$push": "$$ROOT"}}}, {"$unwind": "$rows"}, {"$match": {"$expr": {"$gt": ["$rows.Age", "$avg_age"]}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "Song_Name": "$rows.Song_Name"}}, {"$sort": {"Song_Name": 1}}])
List the distinct countries singers come from, in alphabetical order.
db.singer.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$Country"}}, {"$sort": {"_id": 1}}])
For the cars with 4 cylinders, which model has the largest horsepower?

db.cars_data.aggregate([{"$match": {"Cylinders": 4, "Horsepower": {"$ne": "null"}}}, {"$addFields": {"HorsepowerNum": {"$toInt": "$Horsepower"}}}, {"$sort": {"HorsepowerNum": -1}}, {"$limit": 1}, {"$lookup": {"from": "car_names", "localField": "Id", "foreignField": "MakeId", "as": "car_name"}}, {"$unwind": "$car_name"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "Model": "$car_name.Model"}}])
For each Saab released after 1978, report the full name, the year, and the ratio of weight to horsepower.

db.car_names.aggregate([{"$match": {"Model": "saab"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "cars_data", "localField": "MakeId", "foreignField": "Id", "as": "data"}}, {"$unwind": "$data"}, {"$match": {"data.Year": {"$gt": 1978}, "data.Horsepower": {"$ne": "null"}}}, {"$addFields": {"hp_int": {"$toInt": "$data.Horsepower"}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "Make": 1, "Year": "$data.Year", "ratio": {"$divide": ["$data.Weight", "$hp_int"]}}}, {"$sort": {"Year": 1}}])
How many professionals have performed any treatment to dogs?
db.Treatments.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$professional_id"}}, {"$count": "count"}])
Among the cars that do not have the minimum horsepower , what are the make ids and names of all those with less than 4 cylinders ?

db.cars_data.aggregate([{"$match": {"Horsepower": {"$ne": "null"}}}, {"$addFields": {"HorsepowerNum": {"$toInt": "$Horsepower"}}}, {"$group": {"_id": None, "min_hp": {"$min": "$HorsepowerNum"}, "rows": {"$push": "$$ROOT"}}}, {"$unwind": "$rows"}, {"$match": {"$expr": {"$and": [{"$gt": ["$rows.HorsepowerNum", "$min_hp"]}, {"$lt": ["$rows.Cylinders", 4]}]}}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "car_names", "localField": "rows.Id", "foreignField": "MakeId", "as": "car_name"}}, {"$unwind": "$car_name"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "MakeId": "$car_name.MakeId", "Make": "$car_name.Make"}}, {"$sort": {"MakeId": 1}}])
For each country of origin, find the average miles per gallon of cars.

db.cars_data.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "model_list.json", "localField": "Id", "foreignField": "ModelId", "as": "model"}}, {"$unwind": "$model"}, {"$lookup": {"from": "car_makers", "localField": "model.Maker", "foreignField": "Id", "as": "maker"}}, {"$unwind": "$maker"}, {"$addFields": {"maker_country_int": {"$toInt": "$maker.Country"}}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "countries", "localField": "maker_country_int", "foreignField": "CountryId", "as": "country"}}, {"$unwind": "$country"}, {"$match": {"MPG": {"$ne": "null"}}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$country.CountryName", "average_mpg": {"$avg": {"$toDouble": "$MPG"}}}}, {"$sort": {"_id": 1}}])
What is the total number of countries where Spanish is spoken by the largest percentage of people?

db.countrylanguage.aggregate([{"$sort": {"CountryCode": 1, "Percentage": -1}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$CountryCode", "Language": {"$first": "$Language"}}}, {"$match": {"Language": "Spanish"}}, {"$count": "total"}])
How many singers are there?
db.singer.count_documents({})
Which unique cities are in Asian countries where Chinese is the official language ?

db.country.aggregate([{"$match": {"Continent": "Asia"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "countrylanguage", "let": {"code": "$Code"}, "pipeline": [{"$match": {"$expr": {"$and": [{"$eq": ["$CountryCode", "$$code"]}, {"$eq": ["$Language", "Chinese"]}, {"$eq": ["$IsOfficial", "T"]}]}}}], "as": "chinese_official"}}, {"$match": {"chinese_official": {"$ne": []}}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "city", "localField": "Code", "foreignField": "CountryCode", "as": "cities"}}, {"$unwind": "$cities"}, {"$group": {"_id": "$cities.Name"}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "Name": "$_id"}}, {"$sort": {"Name": 1}}])
Which professionals live in the state of Indiana or have done treatment on more than 2 treatments? List his or her id, last name and cell phone.

db.Professionals.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "Treatments", "localField": "professional_id", "foreignField": "professional_id", "as": "t"}}, {"$addFields": {"treatment_count": {"$size": "$t"}}}, {"$match": {"$or": [{"state": "Indiana"}, {"treatment_count": {"$gt": 2}}]}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "professional_id": 1, "last_name": 1, "cell_number": 1}}, {"$sort": {"professional_id": 1}}])
List the top 3 stadiums by capacity, largest first.
db.stadium.find({}, {"_id": 0, "Name": 1, "Capacity": 1}).sort({"Capacity": -1}).limit(3)
List the dog name, age, and weight of dogs that have been abandoned.
db.Dogs.find({"abandoned_yn": "1"}, {"_id": 0, "name": 1, "age": 1, "weight": 1})
List the first names of students majoring in 600.
db.Student.find({"Major": 600}, {"_id": 0, "Fname": 1})
What are the name of the countries where there is not a single car maker?

db.countries.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "car_makers", "let": {"cid": "$CountryId"}, "pipeline": [{"$addFields": {"CountryInt": {"$toInt": "$Country"}}}, {"$match": {"$expr": {"$eq": ["$CountryInt", "$$cid"]}}}], "as": "makers"}}, {"$match": {"makers": {"$eq": []}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "CountryName": 1}}, {"$sort": {"CountryName": 1}}])
Find the maximum weight for each type of pet. List the maximum weight and pet type.
db.Pets.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$PetType", "max_weight": {"$max": "$weight"}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "PetType": "$_id", "max_weight": 1}}, {"$sort": {"PetType": 1}}])
Which continent is Anguilla in?
db.country.find({"Name": "Anguilla"}, {"_id": 0, "Continent": 1})
Show the student IDs and numbers of friends corresponding to each.
db.Friend.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$student_id", "friend_count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "student_id": "$_id", "friend_count": 1}}, {"$sort": {"student_id": 1}}])
Find the minimum grade of students who have no friends.

db.Highschooler.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "Friend", "localField": "ID", "foreignField": "student_id", "as": "friends"}}, {"$match": {"friends": {"$eq": []}}}, {"$group": {"_id": None, "min_grade": {"$min": "$grade"}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0}}])
What is the number of distinct continents where Chinese is spoken?

db.countrylanguage.aggregate([{"$match": {"Language": "Chinese"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "country", "localField": "CountryCode", "foreignField": "Code", "as": "c"}}, {"$unwind": "$c"}, {"$group": {"_id": "$c.Continent"}}, {"$count": "distinct_continent_count"}])
List each owner's first name, last name, and the size code of their dog.

db.Owners.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "Dogs", "localField": "owner_id", "foreignField": "owner_id", "as": "d"}}, {"$unwind": "$d"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "first_name": 1, "last_name": 1, "size_code": "$d.size_code"}}])
What is the total surface area of the continents Asia and Europe?

db.country.aggregate([{"$match": {"Continent": {"$in": ["Asia", "Europe"]}}}, {"$group": {"_id": None, "total_surface_area": {"$sum": "$SurfaceArea"}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "total_surface_area": 1}}])
What is the average weight of cars each year?
db.cars_data.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$Year", "avg_weight": {"$avg": "$Weight"}}}, {"$sort": {"_id": 1}}])
Find the first names of students who have a dog as a pet.

db.Has_Pet.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "Pets", "localField": "PetID", "foreignField": "PetID", "as": "pet"}}, {"$unwind": "$pet"}, {"$match": {"pet.PetType": "dog"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "Student", "localField": "StuID", "foreignField": "StuID", "as": "student"}}, {"$unwind": "$student"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "Fname": "$student.Fname"}}, {"$sort": {"Fname": 1}}])
List the names of highschoolers in grade 12.
db.Highschooler.find({"grade": 12}, {"_id": 0, "name": 1})
